## Lumen 1.6.1

A lightweight, modern media player for Windows. One file, no installer, no telemetry.
Made with ♥ by Shane Sahadeo.

### Download

| Your PC | File |
|---|---|
| Most Windows PCs (Intel / AMD) | **Lumen.exe** |
| Windows on ARM (Snapdragon laptops, Surface Pro X / 11) | **Lumen-arm64.exe** |

Put the file anywhere and double-click it. Requires Windows 10 or 11 with the Edge WebView2 Runtime (already on Windows 11 and almost all updated Windows 10 PCs).

The exe isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time: click *More info → Run anyway*.

### What's new in 1.6.1
- Fixed a brief flash of the old neon start screen before the simple one appeared.
- The neon glow on buttons, sliders and panels is now off by default (Settings → Appearance, or Shift+G).
- Publisher: Shane Sahadeo, shown in About and in the exe's Properties → Details.

### Also in 1.6
Simpler start screen · right-click quick menu · movable panels and dialogs · chapters · smart Next/Previous through chapters, playlist and folder · audio track switching · Go to time · statistics · volume normalization · video size 50/100/200 % · after-playback actions · favorites with position · opt-in recent files · M3U/M3U8 playlists · thumbnail sheets · minimal view.

Full feature list in the [README](https://github.com/shenvecthor/lumen#readme); all changes in the [changelog](https://github.com/shenvecthor/lumen/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
